def measure(samples):
    """p50 / p95 / max in microseconds."""
    if not samples:
        return (0, 0, 0)
    s = sorted(samples)
    n = len(s)
    p50 = s[int(0.50 * (n - 1))]
    p95 = s[int(0.95 * (n - 1))]
    return (p50, p95, s[-1])


class Probe:
    def __init__(self, name):
        self.name = name
        self.samples = []

    def mark(self, us):
        self.samples.append(us)

    def stats(self):
        return measure(self.samples)
```
